title: Lift agent caps in athena.toml with job_usd covering their sum
summary: Retry of job 20261104-140950-gzp9: apply the nine cap values to athena.toml, raise [budget] job_usd to 50.00 so it covers the $47.00 required by the new caps (2 + 5×(3+3) + 10 + 5), and update the config.rs tests that pin the old values. Audience: the Athena owner and verifier.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check admission budget passes and tests run, not just that values were edited.
Fixes the job_usd-below-sum invariant and the pinned tests rather than only the nine values.
Single config change plus the tests that pin it.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Job 20261104-140950-gzp9 failed: its athena.toml-only edit (kept here as a deliverable) left job_usd 40.00 below the 47.00 required, and four config.rs tests pin old values. This retry fixes both: raises job_usd and updates those tests. The earlier out_of_scope on config.rs is dropped because the tests read athena.toml; the schema code itself stays unchanged.

Code survey: crates/athena-data/src/config.rs. Config::budget_required = reader_usd + max_rounds*(planner_usd+critic_usd) + producer_usd + verifier_usd; check_budget refuses job_usd below it. Tests at ~lines 855-936 and ~1163 pin 0.75, max_rounds 3, job_usd 12.0 and the replace string 'job_usd = 12.00'. Other crates' tests (athena-cli/tests, athena-core) may read athena.toml and are checked by running the workspace tests.
job_usd = 50.00 is chosen (47.00 needed plus headroom); the user's other eight values are as originally stated. CHANGELOG.md was a prior deliverable but is not required; listed with low probability.
The change adds no new refusal rule; it only changes values, so no newly-refused-readings percentage applies.

acceptance_criteria.text: athena.toml [budget] reads reader_usd 2.00, producer_usd 10.00, verifier_usd 5.00, job_usd 50.00 (at least 47.00), producer_timeout_s 5400, verifier_timeout_s 3600; [job_plan] planner_usd 3.00, critic_usd 3.00, max_rounds 5; git diff of athena.toml shows only those value substitutions, no key added or removed, reader_timeout_s, check_timeout_s, planner_timeout_s, critic_timeout_s unchanged.
Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-data`; it passes, including the repository-config budget tests updated to the new values and a test that Config::parse(REPO_CONFIG).check_budget() is ok.
Run `cargo test --locked --workspace`; it passes, so no other test pinning old athena.toml values remains broken; and `cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets` is clean.
Changes to crates/athena-data/src/config.rs are confined to the test module (git diff shows no change outside #[cfg(test)]); the schema and check logic are untouched.
job_usd (50.00) is no less than reader_usd + max_rounds*(planner_usd+critic_usd) + producer_usd + verifier_usd = 47.00, so admission's budget check passes on the new config.

out_of_scope: Changing config schema or non-test logic in crates/athena-data/src/config.rs
Changing keys not listed (reader_timeout_s, check_timeout_s, planner_timeout_s, critic_timeout_s)
Adding a new command to compute minimum job_usd
urgent_reason: Cuts repeat failed attempts: the prior job was refused at admission because job_usd was below the sum of stage caps.
hard_reason: Changes budget limits that admission enforces and can refuse jobs over, so a wrong value blocks all work.
